programs.title: Peter Rabbit
programs.desc: Mischievous Peter and his large family live in a hole next to the garden of the elderly McGregor.Relations between them have long been strained.Unwanted guests regularly steal vegetables and fruits.Their ally is the sensitive artist Bea (Rose Byrne).When an unfriendly senior dies of a heart attack, the rabbits enjoy freedom, but this state does not last long.His relative, Tomasz (Domhnall Gleeson), comes to the estate inherited from the pensioner.Once there, he finds chaos left by the previous owner and a group of intruders who will not give up their habits so easily.The man wants to get rid of pests.However, this will not be an easy task.

programs.title: IO
programs.desc: A donkey working in a circus performs with a young artist (Sandra Drzymalska).When he regains freedom thanks to activists, his wandering begins.During his journey, he experiences joy and pain.

programs.title: Her
programs.desc: Los Angeles.Theodore makes a living by writing letters to order.He experiences a painful divorce from Catherine.His friend Amy supports him in difficult times.He spends his free time playing computer games and occasional dates.One day he buys a new operating system that can meet all user needs.She uses the software's capabilities by communicating with a virtual character with a sensual voice, Samantha.He quickly realizes that this cybernetic consciousness understands him perfectly.He has great knowledge, sense of humor and feelings.Theodore realizes that he has met the ideal woman.Attempts are made to create an unconventional relationship.

programs.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programs.desc: Alita (Rosa Salazar), a cyborg girl, wakes up from a coma.It turns out that he doesn't remember who he is or where he is.Doctor Ido (Christoph Waltz) subjected her to a series of tests that revealed that she was a young woman with a unique story.Wanting to protect her, he does not reveal the truth about her past.Alita must adapt to the conditions and rules of life in Scrap City.After some time, he regains his memory thanks to the help of his friend, Hugo (Keean Johnson).Then he realizes that he has incredible fighting skills.She must use them against the power that tries to control her.The film's director is Robert Rodriguez, known from "From Dusk Till Dawn" and "Machete".The script was written by the winner of three Oscars, James Cameron, who considered making "Alita" back in the 1990s. The film was based on the manga.

programs.title: Living
programs.desc: London, 1953. Rodney Williams (Bill Nighy) has been doing the same boring bureaucratic job for years.A lonely man feels that his life has been meaningless for a long time.One day he learns from the doctor that he has been diagnosed with incurable cancer.Desperate, he goes to a seaside town to commit suicide.However, he changes his mind and spends the night wandering around bars with a writer he meets there, Sutherland (Tom Burke).Back in London, Williams doesn't go to the office.He runs into Margaret Harris (Aimee Lou Wood), a much younger and energetic woman who once worked in his department.He becomes friends with her and she infects him with her enthusiasm.When the man's condition worsens, he decides to do something important.With the help of Peter Wakeling (Alex Sharp), a young idealist from his office, he wants to build a playground, the construction of which he himself had previously blocked.A remake of "The Brand of Death", a drama by Akira Kurosawa, inspired by Leo Tolstoy's short story "The Death of Ivan Ilyich".

programs.title: Passengers
programs.desc: A group of people set off on a spaceship to a planet intended for colonization in a distant galaxy.Since the journey is expected to last 120 years, the expedition participants are put into hibernation.Unfortunately, the system turns out to be unreliable and mechanic Jim wakes up early.Because he feels lonely, he decides to find a companion.His choice falls on the charming writer Aurora.He wakes her up from sleep.They fall in love, but the idyll does not last long.They discover that the spaceship they are traveling on is in great danger, and the lives of other passengers depend only on them.They also gradually realize why their waking up was not accidental.Soon the couple's love is put to a difficult test.

programs.title: Priscilla
programs.desc: Young Elvis Presley (Jacob Elrodi) meets teenage Priscilla Beaulieu (Cailee Spaeny).He begins to prepare the girl for the role of his future wife.Over time, a serious feeling develops between them.However, life in the spotlight exposes their relationship to numerous tests, including from the star's numerous lovers.Priscilla, living detached from reality, slowly begins to learn about herself.Will her transformation affect the future of this marriage?Sofia Coppola returns with another story about female youth."Priscilla" is the result of the director's cooperation with the ex-wife of the American rock star, Elvis Presley.The director of "Curses of Innocence" and "Temptation" once again juxtaposes passion, romance and great love with the cruel realities of life.

programs.title: Euphoria
programs.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programs.title: Lord Of The Flies
programs.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programs.title: A Working Man
programs.desc: Former Royal Marines Levon Cade (Jason Statham) leaves his military career to lead the life of a construction worker.His plans for a peaceful retirement as a foreman are disrupted by the news of the abduction of his boss's (Michael Pena) teenage daughter, Jenny Garcia (Arianna Rivas).The girl became a victim of the Russian mafia led by Kharchenko (Andrei Kaminsky).Levon initially refuses to get involved in the case, but after consulting with his old friend, he decides to take up arms again.He uses his experience and contacts to save the hostage.The mission turns into a real massacre.The film's script was co-written by Sylwester Stallone.

programs.title: Destiny
programs.desc: The development of science and the emergence of time travel provide a chance to avoid the largest bomb attack in history.The explosion had occurred in New York ten years earlier.The risky task is undertaken by a secret government agency headed by Robertson.He realizes the danger.Since any interference with past events can irreversibly change the present, he develops a plan to eliminate the terrorist without side effects.He chooses a random agent to carry out the mission.He is to recruit a younger version of the criminal into his organization.At the same time, he makes surprising discoveries about himself.

programs.title: 30 days of darkness
programs.desc: The town of Barrow, Alaska, goes dark for thirty days every year.Most residents leave their homes at this time.The safety of those who decided to stay is ensured by young sheriff Eben Olsen (Josh Hartnett).He is struggling with serious personal problems.His marriage with Stella (Melissa George) is in crisis and she wants to leave him.Soon, however, they must unite their forces and fight the vampires who attack a town cut off from the world and plunged in darkness.Hungry monsters launch a bloody hunt for people imprisoned in Barrow.Eben, Stella and a handful of survivors begin their fight for survival.They do everything to wait for the end of the polar night.Adapted from a comic book by Steve Niles and Ben Templesmith.
